summary: The note describes Veoh, an Internet television company based in San Diego, California. It offers users access to major studio content, independent productions, and user-generated material. The company is described as a subsidiary of the Israeli start-up Qlipso.
one_line: Veoh is a San Diego-based Internet television company offering studio, independent, and user-generated video, owned by Israeli start-up Qlipso.
key_facts: Veoh is an Internet television company.
Veoh is based in San Diego, California.
Veoh allows users to find and watch major studio content.
Veoh allows users to find and watch independent productions.
Veoh allows users to find and watch user-generated material.
Veoh is a subsidiary of the Israeli start-up Qlipso.
